{{Quote|We must prevent the Ghrag from acquiring these weapons. They have made contact with a weapons dealer named Faydo Sha from Corellia. You may have heard of him. He was a supplier for the Rebellion until they discovered him to be a prolific slave-trader.|Eyma|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Faydo Sha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] supplier for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. However, he was dismissed from the Rebellion when it was discovered he was a prolific [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Eyma]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with intercepting Sha and [[Death/Legends|killing]] him while he was being escorted through the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Faydo Sha was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the [[2005]] expansion pack for the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
